title: A salon marketing checklist for savvy text messaging

facts.fact: The author recommends that salons and spas send a text reminder between 24 and 48 hours before the appointment.
facts.quote: I always recommend salons and spas send a text reminder between 24-48 hours before the appointment.

facts.fact: The author recommends a 24-48 hour reminder for increasing attendance at promotional events.
facts.quote: Again, I’d go for a 24-48 hour reminder.

facts.fact: The author says that for appointment reminders, 48 hours beforehand works best and texting the day before is too late.
facts.quote: I think 48 hours beforehand works best.

facts.fact: The author states that a text message has a 160-character limit, so promotional texts should be brief.
facts.quote: You have 160 characters so be brief, and stay focused.

facts.fact: The Lockhart Meyer Market Your Salon membership can be tried free for one month, according to the vendor's promotion.
facts.quote: Try Market Your Salon membership FREE for a month...

facts.fact: The vendor's free-trial promotion for Market Your Salon membership is listed as ending on 10 September.
